brief:
Israeli settlers have intensified attacks on residents of Khirbet Umm al-Khair in the southern Hebron Hills, according to Palestine News Network, subjecting the community to sustained pressure campaigns aimed at forcing them from their land. The repeated assaults have made fear a constant feature of daily life for families in the village.

Residents face mounting violence and displacement pressure, yet many remain reluctant to leave. The community's deep historical ties to the area, combined with limited alternatives, have kept families anchored despite the escalating threat. Settler attacks and intimidation tactics continue to target the village as part of broader efforts to control territory in the West Bank.

title: Israeli settlers intensify attacks on Palestinian family in Hebron Hills
